[The Start of Reference Answer]
The greenhouse effect is a natural and beneficial process that keeps Earth's temperature comfortable for life. It occurs when the Earth's surface radiates heat energy into the atmosphere, where greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide and water vapor absorb the heat and re-emit it in all directions, including back towards the Earth's surface. This process maintains the Earth's average surface temperature at around 15°C (59°F) instead of the chilly -18°C (0°F) it would be without the greenhouse effect.
However, human activities such as burning fossil fuels and deforestation have led to an enhanced greenhouse effect, where the concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere has increased, trapping more heat and leading to global warming. 
[The End of Reference Answer]
